text:
jordan_billing: Heads up  ProServe Feb invoice (INV-2026-0042) appears to include duplicated Dedicated GPU-hours line items. Total discrepancy ~ $3,400. Need to create a vendor credit and get finance sign-off.

maria_ops: Can you paste the invoice lines so AR can match?

jordan_billing: Pasted redacted excerpt from invoice:

``
INV-2026-0042
PO: PO-77841
Line 12: Dedicated GPU-hours - 480h @ $6.50 = $3,120
Line 13: Dedicated GPU-hours (appears duplicate) - 480h @ $6.50 = $3,120
Subtotal billed: $6,240
Our expected: $3,120
Discrepancy: $3,120 + $280 tax = $3,400
```

eli_engineer: We had a tagging bug in the Dedicated autoscale telemetry around 2026-02-28 that duplicated meter entries. Patch deployed 2026-02-28 02:29 UTC. Logged in internal incident AT-2026-1145.

tess_sales: This is the partner account with committed FY credits I agree we should request a full vendor credit. Include a note referencing the PO and partner SLA.

jordan_billing: Draft credit memo queued: "Credit memo BL-CR-2026-045 for INV-2026-0042: Duplicate billing of Dedicated GPU-hours. Credit amount $3,400. Apply to next invoice or issue refund per vendor preference."

alex_fin: Please propose GL allocation. I suggest: "5100-ADJ - Vendor Adjustments" and memo code "VND-INV-ERR-2026". Approve?

maria_ops: Approving GL and memo. Also request vendor confirmation note for audit.

billing-bot: Created credit memo BL-CR-2026-045, status: pending-approval. Linked audit ticket AT-2026-1145.

alex_fin: Approved. Authorize AR to send memo to vendor and request application to next invoice or refund. CC tess_sales and maria_ops.

jordan_billing: Sending memo to vendor now, requesting written acknowledgment and whether they prefer refund vs apply-to-next-invoice. Will update when they respond.

tess_sales: Please ask them to include an expected timeline for refund if they choose cash. We need that for forecasting.

jordan_billing: Will request timeline. Closing loop here once vendor replies.
